# Supplier Subcontractor Change Governance

## Purpose

Assess material risk when a supplier adds, replaces, or materially changes subcontractors or subprocessors.

## Requirements

Material changes SHOULD be reviewed for service scope, data access, location, security/privacy obligations, concentration, resilience, and contractual rights where relevant.

A change that preserves the primary supplier name can still alter the underlying risk profile.
